witness1_orphanedUnroutedDoor.evidence: resolveAtoms had exactly ONE consumer — demo/stories/aurora/AuroraAtomsPanel.vue (a standalone Aurora+Collapsible panel) — and that panel was NOT routed: `grep AuroraAtomsPanel demo/stories/manifest.ts` = 0. The REAL routed story is demo/stories/substrates/aurora.vue → AuroraConfigDock + the six config/*Layer.vue panels, which mutate the full AuroraConfig DIRECTLY (MediumLayer.vue:22 `props.config.medium = …`) and NEVER call resolveAtoms. The substrate built to 'simplify the options' was bypassed by the only shipped UI.
witness1_orphanedUnroutedDoor.disposition: FIXED — AuroraConfigDock now drives the atoms door by DEFAULT (an 'Atoms' tab as the default surface, the six raw layers behind an 'Advanced' tab); AuroraAtomsPanel is REBUILT as the live ≤7-atom control surface; the aurora story routes the atoms-default door (the routed substrates/aurora.vue passes dockTab=ref('atoms')).

witness2_deadSecondDoor.disposition: FIXED — deriveScene + AuroraMood + MOOD_RECIPE + thirdsNuclei DELETED; the barrel + /api re-exports removed. The only unique value (the mood→medium/temperatureShift/chromaEasing coupling) folded into the surviving door's COLOR atom (colorEnergy → temperatureShift on the palette derive). `grep deriveScene|AuroraMood|MOOD_RECIPE|thirdsNuclei src/` = 0.

witness3_duplicatedPriors.evidence: thirdsZones (atoms.ts:101) and thirdsNuclei (color.ts:276) were near-identical duplicates (same anchor table, same construction). witness3_duplicatedPriors.disposition: FIXED — ONE nucleiPrior(count, arrangement) in atoms.ts is the single source (proof gate asserts exactly one); ONE COLOR-energy curve (the COLOR_ENERGY poles + lerp) replaces both mood tables.

witness4_noiseHasNoDoor.evidence: The user named the atoms as 'zones, noise, color' (§2.7). The shipped AuroraAtoms split COLOR awkwardly across seed+harmony+mood, ZONES was a bare integer on a FIXED thirds prior, and NOISE was not an atom at all: `grep warpMode|warpScale|noiseOctaves atoms.ts` = 0; warpAmount was reached only as a mood side-effect.
witness4_noiseHasNoDoor.disposition: FIXED — the re-derived AuroraAtoms carries a NOISE atom (one 0..1 organic-boundary scalar) fanning to warpAmount + warpScale + warpMode (fBm→hybrid→cellular) + noiseOctaves; ZONES is {count, arrangement} (scattered/composed/centred selects the prior); COLOR is seed + harmony + colorEnergy (a continuous energy curve).

witness5_silentInertArms.evidence: applyTexture (atoms.ts:148) had a `case "smooth": default:` empty no-op (textureAmount on smooth silently did nothing). The interactivity atom's flow/wake axes were declared + passed through (atoms.ts:226) but only light+scroll are wired downstream (`grep .flow|.wake frameLoop.ts useAurora.ts` shows only light+scroll consumed).
witness5_silentInertArms.disposition: FIXED — texture is STRUCTURALLY ABSENT on smooth (AuroraMediumAtom is a discriminated union: the `{kind:"smooth"}` arm has no `amount` field; TypeScript narrows it away — proof gate + a @ts-expect-error test assert it). The interactivity atom (AuroraInteractivityAtom) ships ONLY light + scroll; flow/wake are EXCISED until wired (the full AuroraConfig.interactivity author schema keeps all four for authors — only the ATOM door narrows).

witness6_greenGateOverDeadDoor.evidence: proof:aurora-atoms-roundtrip was GREEN + rigorous (2000+ combination totality fuzz, default-preservation deep-equal) but proved a property of a door NOTHING SHIPPED THROUGH and asserted NOTHING about reachability or render.
witness6_greenGateOverDeadDoor.disposition: FIXED — proof:aurora-atoms-roundtrip EXTENDED: kept (a) totality + default-preservation, ADDED (b) reachability (the story is routed + the dock drives via resolveAtoms + the atoms tab is default), (c) dead-door grep=0 + exactly-one-nucleiPrior, (d) noise-atom-fans-out + texture-absent-on-smooth. ratify1_atomDecomposition.decision: RATIFIED — the ≤7 atoms are the user's named control elements (§2.7), corpus-confirmed (facet 26): COLOR (seed + harmony + colorEnergy), ZONES (count + arrangement: scattered/composed/centred), NOISE (one organic-boundary 0..1 knob → warpAmount/warpScale/warpMode/noiseOctaves), MEDIUM ({kind, amount?} — amount textured-only), MOTION (still/breathing/drifting).
ratify1_atomDecomposition.moodFold: The prior mood→energy fan-out folds INTO the COLOR-energy atom (a CONTINUOUS scalar t∈[0,1] driving a curve over saturation + valueVariance + breathDepth + the palette temperatureShift — the corpus's named co-varying-axes successor, facet 26, not a 3-point LUT).
ratify1_atomDecomposition.arrangementEnum: AuroraZoneArrangement = scattered | composed | centred — selects among golden-scatter / rule-of-thirds / central-cluster priors; the seed-stable scatter uses the φ⁻¹ low-discrepancy walk (facet 27).
ratify1_atomDecomposition.flowWakeVerdict: EXCISE — flow/wake are NOT wired downstream (only light/scroll are), so they are excised from the shipped AuroraInteractivityAtom until wired (the excise-or-wire mandate). The full AuroraConfig.interactivity author schema is UNCHANGED (keeps all four for hand-authoring).
